errorCodes.meaning: The request has expired or was already consumed.
The request has already been approved or declined.
The cancel is signed by neither the starter key nor the lock key.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

RequestId.description: The service-generated handle of one request: 16 to 32 bytes from a cryptographically secure random source, written as unpadded base64url (22 to 43 characters; 16 bytes, 22 characters, is RECOMMENDED). It is also the nonce of the exchange, so the family needs no separate challenge, and it is the `_id` of the trigger link (VTI-LNK-033). Compared as a string. It confers no authority on its holder.
RequestId.title: RequestId

Response.description: Confirms the request is cancelled. Cancelling an already-cancelled request answers the same way.
Response.title: Auth — OOB Cancel — response payload

schema.description: The starter or the lock holder ends an out-of-band request. Issued and signed by the starter key or by the lock key. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, parentThreadId, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.
